text:
Working on a tool to provide a thin OIDC auth layer for self-hosted LLM engines. Users log in with your Org's identity provider, generate an API key for themselves, point their harnesses at your instance of the relay, and then they're off to the races.

No web chat interface, no call-us-for-pricing feature gating, just a tight Erlang program for people who want to get shit done!
